name: California Senate Bill 867 — Toys: Companion Chatbots
description: California legislation restricting the manufacture, distribution, and sale of physical children's toys embedded with open-ended AI companion chatbot functionality capable of unscripted emotional or conversational interaction with minors.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by California State (ca.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within California State (ca.gov).
